concept.exothermic.excerpt: Reactions that release energy are exothermic.

concept.endothermic.excerpt: Reactions that absorb energy are endothermic.

concept.enthalpySign.excerpt: negative value of an enthalpy change, Δ H < 0, indicates an exothermic reaction; a positive value, Δ H > 0, indicates an endothermic reaction.

concept.formationZero.excerpt: By definition, the standard enthalpy of formation of an element in its most stable form is equal to zero under standard conditions
